theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_mm_isMinimizingIn_univ
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ Us j) → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → ConvergesWeakly Ss C → (∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∀ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ → ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ ∃ φ' : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ' ∧ ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity S → SameBoundary S C → (S - C).support ⊆ K → limsup (fun j => (Ss (ψ (φ' j))).massOn W) atTop ≤ S.massOn W) → IsMinimizingIn C univ
